$comment: design §7.2 (the four closed vocabularies), §7.3 (proposal content and the structural rules), §7.4 (placement, through tables/placement_rules.json and packets/placement_contract.md), §7.5 (the ranking keys this carries), §10.4 (ledger-only dispositions carry no operations); plan WP-12. This schema holds the SHAPE of one S7 answer. What it may not hold is the contract: the allowed (kind, diagnosis) -> disposition pairs, the structural rules and the placement rules live in tables/allowed_pairs.json, tables/structural_rules.json and tables/placement_rules.json, read by runlib/placement.py, because a vocabulary written twice is two authorities. So `disposition` is an enum here and WHICH disposition is allowed for this candidate is not. `unknowns` is where a named state of the derivation (a unit outcome not derived, delivery not assembled, an arc confirmation undetermined) is carried forward instead of being read as a negative answer.
title: S7 proposal

keep_record_named.$comment: The active keep record a reduce or merge supersedes; structural rule KEEP_GUARDED reads it.

harmful.$comment: A reduce of a unit that is covered and followed is allowed only when the unit is harmful (§7.2's condition `reduce_when_harmful`, read by runlib/placement.py). The flag is the model's claim, and the reason field says on what.

requires_R.$comment: A core item needs an R comparison; §10.4 and WP-20 read it, and an item admitted by adjudication in the second pass is awaiting_R and enters no F this run.

before_state_sha256.$comment: Every operation carries the expected before-state hash of its target (§7.3); `absent` is the create case, where the target does not exist yet and the hash of nothing would be a hash of something.

names.$comment: For a route: the path the entry points at. runlib/sequencing.py reads it to ask whether an intermediate tree would hold a route to nothing.

korean.$comment: null only where the item is not user-facing; the reason belongs in reasons.proposal.

layer.$comment: Judged against tables/placement_rules.json `destinations.order`, not enumerated here: one authority for the layers.

carrier.$comment: null for a disposition that carries no operations; a placed item names the file or entry that carries it.

reasons.$comment: The person reads these, so they are Korean; the share is a non-blocking diagnostic of S9b, never a gate here.

unknown.$comment: A named state of the derivation this proposal would have rested on, carried forward by name: the field, the state as the derivation spelled it, and what the proposal does about it.
